audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is described only as 'his early bullies you' with no named mechanic, and the level chart hands Renekton First item and 2+ items despite a 53.47% Malphite win rate over 1382 games and Renekton having no scaling.
audit.why: Renekton's power is entirely Fury-gated and pre-item. Ruthless Predator (W) is 16s at rank 1 and only 8s at rank 5, so early lane difficulty is real but item-timing dominance is Malphite's. Ground Slam (E) scales off Armor, so every armour item widens the gap.
audit.corrected: Early (Levels 1-3) is Renekton's outright; Levels 4-5 are contested; from Level 6 and the first armour item onward the lane is Malphite's, and 2+ items is a hard Malphite phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Power spikes never use real cooldown numbers and mislabel Renekton's dash as 'W'.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator (W) 16/14/12/10/8s is the stun; Slice and Dice (E) 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s is the dash. Dominus (R) is 120/100/80s. Malphite's Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s.
audit.corrected: Renekton spikes on Fury availability and rank-ups of Ruthless Predator; Malphite spikes at Level 6 (Unstoppable Force, 130s) and again on the first armour item, because Ground Slam's damage is armour-scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two decisive kit interactions: empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields (i.e. Granite Shield), and empowered Slice and Dice reduces Armor, which directly reduces Ground Slam's damage.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Ruthless Predator reads 'destroying damage shields on the target' at 50+ Fury; Granite Shield is a damage shield worth 10% max HP and is explicitly called Malphite's trade margin elsewhere on the page. Slice and Dice empowered 'reduces the Armor of units hit', and Ground Slam deals 'magic damage based on his Armor'.
audit.corrected: Above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator strips Granite Shield before the stun damage lands, so the whole trade is paid at full price. Empowered Slice and Dice shreds armour, which shrinks Ground Slam's damage as well as your durability. Do not trade into full Fury.

audit.why: Cull the Meek (Q) heals off every target hit on a 7s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds matters; the itemization line already names anti-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to 'walk off his W dash', which does not exist.
audit.why: Renekton has no dash on W. Slice and Dice (E) is the dash and it is a two-charge in/out; the escape half is what he needs to leave.
audit.corrected: Bait the first Slice and Dice cast, then punish — his exit is the second charge, and at rank 1 the pair is on a 16s cooldown.

edits.before: Renekton owns these levels outright and you have to accept it — he is a point-click fury bully with a W stun and empowered Dice combo, and you have zero trade pattern before W and E come online. Do not try to contest autos; last-hit at the tip of your Q (Seismic Shard) range and let Granite Shield soak his harass between waves. If he dashes in with W to stun you, just walk it off and refresh your shield — his fury burns out fast and he can't sustain his own aggression once you deny the all-in.
edits.after: Renekton owns these levels outright and you have to accept it — Ruthless Predator (W) stuns on a 16s cooldown at rank 1, and above 50 Fury it slashes three times and destroys damage shields, so it deletes Granite Shield before the damage lands. Last-hit at the tip of Seismic Shard (625 range) and never trade into full Fury. He closes with Slice and Dice (E), not W — bait the first charge, walk out of the second, and let your shield recharge while his Fury bleeds away.

edits.before: Renekton's danger window — his W stun and fury-empowered Dice combo point-and-click bully you before W/E come online, so hug the wave and eat minimal poke.
edits.after: Renekton's danger window — Ruthless Predator (W) stuns, and above 50 Fury it destroys Granite Shield outright, so hug the wave and never trade him at full Fury.

edits.before: His fury-empowered W combo hits hardest here while you still lack W armor and E — do not contest, just refresh Granite Shield.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator (W) destroys damage shields — it strips Granite Shield before the stun, so refuse trades above 50 Fury.

edits.before: W (Thunderclap) armor and E (Ground Slam) attack-speed slow come online — you stabilize and farm through his trades, but he can still edge a clean W combo.
edits.after: Thunderclap (W) and Ground Slam (E) stabilize you, but empowered Slice and Dice (E) shreds armour, and Ground Slam's damage scales off armour, so it lands softer.

edits.before: Slam his Level 1-3 fury combo (W stun into empowered autos) before your W/E sustain exists
edits.after: Shatter Granite Shield with empowered Ruthless Predator (W), then heal it off Cull the Meek (Q)

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade on Ruthless Predator's cooldown — 12s at rank 3. Empowered Slice and Dice shreds armour, so armour-scaling Ground Slam hits softer.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Respect Renekton's Ruthless Predator completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Seismic Shard (8s) pokes and steals his move speed, but respect Ruthless Predator: above 50 Fury it destroys Granite Shield, so bank small advantages rather than proving a point.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16/14/12/10/8s — above 50 Fury it destroys Granite Shield, so bait it out. - Slice and Dice: 16s at rank 1, his only way in and out. - Unstoppable Force: 130s at rank 1 — kill windows only.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1; empowered strips Granite Shield. Engage only once spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury it destroys Granite Shield, so the stun lands on bare HP.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator (W) destroys damage shields — Granite Shield included. Engage when it is down.

notes: Malphite kit file's derived flags misfire: Seismic Shard (Q) and Ground Slam (E) both carry a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's descriptions describe only a move-speed steal and an attack-speed slow respectively — Malphite grounds nothing. I never asserted grounding anywhere. Unstoppable Force (R) also carries a 'projectile' flag; the description is a self-dash, so I did not claim Wind Wall-class blocking. I aligned only the two late stages (First item, 2+ items) to Malphite in BOTH layers, which the 53.47% win rate and Renekton's zero scaling support; I left the Level 1-3 stages alone because changing 'Skill' to 'Renekton' would break the length band.
